=== EMAIL to primary@example.com
Subject: Passing p.stonn on to a neighbour
Provenance: You received this at primary@example.com because this address manages, or shares access to, a p.stonn account that schedules a visitor parking permit. p.stonn is a free, unofficial scheduler for City of Stonnington visitor parking permits.

Hi, you’ve had p.stonn looking after your visitor permit for a couple of weeks now.

If p.stonn has been handy, you might know someone else in Stonnington with a visitor permit who’d get some use out of it too.

Send them an invitation: https://p.stonn.org/share
Or print a card with a QR code they can scan to get started: https://p.stonn.org/share#card
